text:
maria: Heads-up — FinTrust onboarding asks for a 'role separation & audit proof' package for their Dedicated cluster. They want: role mapping, example audit exports (SIEM-ready), KMS envelope proof + rotation policy, and a timeline for the open vuln in libcrypto they found. Can we assemble? cc @kevin @ashley
kevin: Got it. Do we have a canonical role matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted? I can pull the current IAM mapping from infra repo and produce a CSV.
nashley: I can produce an export of recent audit logs (last 30 days) with redaction. Need to confirm fields FinTrust wants: who/what/where/how (user, action, resource, ip, request_id).
maria: Yes, they listed those fields. Also they want NDJSON (one JSON object per line) so it's easy to ingest into Splunk. Include a README with retention windows + export steps.
devin: For KMS: FinTrust asks for envelope encryption proof that customer-managed keys are used for tenant data at rest for Dedicated. We have HSM-backed keys for private deployments; need to show key IDs and a signed manifest. @samir do we have a template for a key-proof manifest?
samir: We have a signed-manifest flow used for Orion pilot, but it's a bit bespoke. I can adapt it. Will need a notarized key thumbprint and a rotation log showing the last 3 rotations. Also collate KMS IAM bindings (which service accounts have Encrypt/Decrypt).
ashley: Quick note on logs: to satisfy PCI-like asks we should include a sample KMS decrypt call (redacted). We should show caller identity, time, and request_id. Example snippet: ```json
{"time":"2026-02-23T14:02:11Z","service":"kms","action":"Decrypt","caller":"service-account:dedicated-gateway","request_id":"req_abc123"}
```
kevin: Vuln triage: FinTrust flagged CVE-2026-1111 in libcrypto on some deploy boxes. We already rolled an upgrade/patch last week; will provide CPE, patch diff, and mitigation notes (upgraded to libcrypto 3.2.1, backported patches, chrooted builds). I'll attach the CVE triage notes to the package.
maria: Great. Also can we include a short incident response runbook (who to call, P0 contacts, expected SLAs for evidence requests) — FinTrust explicitly wants 24/7 contact for the first 30 days post-onboarding.
devin: I can draft the runbook. Suggested sections: scope, escalation matrix, evidence export steps, SLA table, on-call contacts (pager links). I propose adding a canonical play for compromised KMS keys.
samir: ETA: I can produce key manifest + rotation proof by EOD tomorrow. Ashley can export redacted logs by EOD today. Kevin will provide vuln triage doc first thing tomorrow morning.
sec-bot: incident-bot: new evidence request created FINTRUST-2026-003, ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-7890
maria: Perfect. I'll consolidate into the package and send initial deliverable to FinTrust SOC by tomorrow noon. Thanks team :thumbsup:
